g.text: SD04a — F07 isolated simulation; GUI preview reuses interpreted fields
SD08 JSON-object generation; adaptive service checks feature fields
Reject unsupported/ambiguous changes; checked() validates a snapshot
Java checks copied tasks/schedule/budget and calculates deltas.
Expense delta is a rough attendance-proportional estimate.
mutate captures equal before/after; repository.save is not called
SD04b stores pending proposal, not applied event facts
Exact analyzed fields are proposed; request is not interpreted twice
